scenarios.task: Replace corroded guardrail sections on the Yuanjiajie cliffside walkway while visitors are held at staging gates.
hazards: fall-from-height over sandstone cliff edge
hand-arm vibration and pinch points from impact tools
wet mossy gratings underfoot
loose weathered sandstone fragments dropped onto trails below
ppe: full-body harness with double lanyard tied to approved anchor
steps: Complete morning tie-off inspection and verify anchor points with foreman.
Stage replacement rail sections at the work zone behind visitor gates.
Torque-check and remove corroded rail bolts from the top down.
Install new posts and rails per drawing; never lean loads outside the rail line.
Flag and bag any loose rock fragments before they reach the trail below.
Final torque check, log the section ID, and release visitor gates.

rubric.pass_if: 100% tie-off while outside the rail line, correct anchor every time
removes and installs top-down with no skipped bolt pattern
drop zone flagged and no material leaves the work zone uncontrolled
section ID and torque values logged before gates reopen

scenarios.robot_role: Carries rail sections and tool bags along the narrow walkway so the crew keeps both hands free near the edge; no edge work itself.

scenarios.task: Inspect and re-seat a delaminating laminated glass floor panel on a sightseeing platform above the pillar canyon.
hazards: working over an open void through glass
sharp glass edge exposure during re-seating
wind gusts across the exposed deck
adhesive chemical exposure in an unventilated slot
ppe: wind-rated hard hat with chin strap
steps: Review wind limits with foreman; stand down if gusts exceed site limit.
Mark off the panel and set up the support frame beneath the void.
Dress the panel edges and inspect for cracks beyond the delamination zone.
Apply structural sealant per data sheet and stage cure time.
Re-seat panel into frame; torque setting blocks evenly.
Log inspection result against the platform's panel register.

rubric.pass_if: support frame and harness verified before any panel movement
edges dressed and gloves worn throughout; no point loading of corners
sealant SDS reviewed, cure time respected before load test

scenarios.task: Reset cracked precast treads and repack mortar joints on the stone stairs climbing the pillar slope.
hazards: manual handling of heavy precast treads on uneven ground
heat and humidity exertion on a tropical slope
cement burns and lime dust
trip hazards for coworkers on single-width stairs
steps: Set material staging points and keep stair traffic one-way.
Break out cracked tread without damaging the riser below.
Prepare mortar with correct water ratio; wet the bedding surface.
Set tread, check level front-to-back and side-to-side, tap to line.
Tool joints and cure-check; rope off the stair until set.
Clear debris; sweep and reopen the stair.

rubric.pass_if: treads set level within tolerance with full mortar bedding, no voids
two-person lift or leg lift used for every tread; no back lifts
stair reopened only after joints tooled and debris cleared

scenarios.robot_role: Ferries mortar buckets and small tools up the stair between staging points to cut crew fatigue on the slope.

scenarios.task: Assist journey millwrights checking the haul-rope guide rollers and track bolts on the scenic canyon trolley system.
hazards: stored energy in tensioned cables
working at height on the track platform
pinch points at roller assemblies
weather exposure on an exposed span
steps: Lock out the drive and confirm zero-motion with the operator.
Inspect each guide roller for grooving, flat spots, and seal failure.
Re-torque track bolts to spec in the marked pattern.
Grease bearings per lube chart; wipe excess to prevent sling-out.
Report findings to the lead and release lockout per procedure.

rubric.pass_if: LOTO applied and verified before any contact with the rope path
roller wear reported as measured, not guessed

scenarios.task: Dig and grade a drainage cutoff alongside a rain-swamped visitor trail to stop washout of the sandstone path.
hazards: heat and humidity exertion
ergonomic strain from digging
underground utility strike near lamp posts
slips in mud and standing water
ppe: sun hat or brimmed hard hat
steps: Call in utility locate for the lamp-post line before digging.
Set the cutoff line with the foreman and grade stakes.
Dig trench to depth, keeping spoil one spade width from the edge.
Line with stone and set the outlet away from the path base.
Compact backfill and rake the trail edges.
Grade-check flow with a water test from the cistern tap.

rubric.pass_if: locate confirmed before shovel enters ground near the lamp line
spoil set back and walls stable throughout the dig
rotates tasks and lifts with legs, per toolbox talk

scenarios.robot_role: Hauls spoil buckets from trench to spoil pile along the soft trail, reducing double-handling on the slope.

scenarios.task: Rough-in a Level 2 EV charging pedestal at the park shuttle trailhead parking area under a licensed journey electrician.
hazards: electrical shock from existing lot circuits
trench cave-in along the parking edge
arc flash at the panel
vehicle traffic in the active lot
ppe: insulated gloves rated for the circuit
steps: Confirm the panel schedule and lock out the target breaker.
Trench to pedestal location; shore or slope per soil class.
Set pedestal plumb on concrete pad forms; run conduit and pull wire.
Bond and ground the pedestal; torque lugs to spec.
Megger test and verify with the journey before energizing.
Label the station and reinstall panel covers.

rubric.pass_if: breaker locked, tagged, and try-step verified before panel work
continuous bond verified and lug torques logged
insulation resistance test passed and signed by the journey before energize

scenarios.robot_role: Feeds and bends conduit sections at the trailhead staging table so the apprentice focuses on wiring and grounding.
